lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Three distinct horizontal tiers of high-luminance circular clusters; the medial row displays the highest pixel intensity and greatest spatial diameter, arranged in a linear series along the mid-lateral line.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal spot rows, creating a grid-like matrix where the intersections serve as the anchor points for the primary high-luminance blobs.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three horizontal linear features running parallel to the long axis of the body; the most prominent ridge exhibits a sharp vertical luminance gradient with high-intensity pixels on the upper edge and a low-intensity shadow zone immediately below.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse, low-contrast distribution of high-luminance points; the majority of the first dorsal fin silhouette appears as a uniform dark-gray macro-mask with minimal internal feature contrast.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a high-contrast remora attached to the ventral surface posterior to the left pectoral fin; prominent high-luminance spots are visible on the superior lobe of the caudal fin.
